bim-intern.title: BIM Intern - Architecture
bim-intern.description: We are looking for a BIM Intern to join our Pune studio. Responsibilities: develop Building Information Modelling (BIM) models in Autodesk Revit to LOD 300; create and manage Revit families; support clash detection and coordination in Navisworks; prepare construction documentation and working drawings; assist with presentation renders. Requirements: final-year B.Arch student or recent graduate; proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD is required; working knowledge of Navisworks; familiarity with Dynamo is a plus; strong attention to detail and communication.

junior-architect.title: Junior Architect
junior-architect.description: Junior Architect for residential and institutional projects. You will prepare working drawings, GFC drawings and municipal approval drawings, coordinate with structural and MEP consultants, attend site visits, and produce 3D views and renders for client presentations. Must have B.Arch; proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp; Revit preferred; knowledge of building bye-laws; good presentation skills. 0-2 years of experience.

interior-designer.title: Junior Interior Designer
interior-designer.description: Hiring a Junior Interior Designer for cafe, retail and residential fit-outs. Responsibilities: space planning and furniture layouts, mood boards and material selection, joinery details and shop drawings, 3D visualisation in SketchUp with V-Ray or Enscape renders, preparing BOQs. Requirements: B.Des or diploma in interior design; AutoCAD and SketchUp required; Photoshop; good client presentation skills.

site-engineer.title: Graduate Site Engineer - Civil
site-engineer.description: Graduate Site Engineer for high-rise residential projects. Duties: site execution and supervision of RCC works, checking reinforcement against bar bending schedules (BBS), quality control (QA/QC) and cube testing records, quantity take-off and preparation of RA bills, daily progress reports. Requirements: B.Tech/B.E. Civil; AutoCAD required; knowledge of IS 456; STAAD Pro is an advantage; Primavera P6 or MS Project for planning is a plus; willingness to work on site.

design-engineer.title: Graduate Design Engineer - Mechanical
design-engineer.description: Graduate Engineer Trainee (Design). You will create 3D CAD models and assemblies in SolidWorks or CATIA, prepare manufacturing drawings with GD&T, perform FEA in ANSYS to validate parts, and support design for manufacturing (DFM) reviews. Requirements: B.E./B.Tech Mechanical; SolidWorks required; ANSYS and FEA knowledge required; CFD exposure is a plus; MATLAB preferred; CSWA certification an advantage.
